title: Mission Shakti: How India’s 2019 anti-sat missile test in space caught US off guard

title: JK Rowling donated £10m for MS clinic in her mother’s name; it now helps thousands

The clinic focuses on research and treatment of various neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease. The funding aims to attract world-class researchers to develop new therapies and potentially find a cure. It has already hosted numerous clinical appointments and research projects since its inception.

title: California family’s 6,625-acre cattle ranch protected after 112 years

David Johnson, a family member, was instrumental in this initiative, with the Northcoast Regional Land Trust planning to acknowledge their dedication to conservation this coming October.

title: Only 15% going to work use public transport: NSO

It reveals that 46% of workers rely on two-wheelers and cars, leading to traffic congestion. Walking is the second most common commute mode, with 28.3% of workers traveling on foot. Student commuting patterns differ significantly, with 37% walking to educational institutions.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35m mansion: Why does it have a $1.75m twin in Illinois?

Both properties were designed by architect Jarvis Hunt for steel magnate Jay C. Morse, with the Ohio estate reportedly based on his earlier Illinois residence. The 10,000-square-foot House of Seven Gables retains historic details, including fireplaces, oak panelling, beamed ceilings and carved woodwork, despite being relocated in 2017.

title: Naomi Osaka’s family mission: How did her Haitian roots inspire her work?
